name: What does the sewage cleanup process involve?

mainEntity.name: What does the sewage cleanup process involve?

acceptedAnswer.text: The sewage cleanup process typically involves several stages: initial assessment and safety protocols, water extraction, removal of contaminated materials, thorough cleaning and disinfection using specialized antimicrobial agents, drying of affected structures, and odor removal. Finally, restoration work is performed to repair or replace damaged building materials. Each step is carefully executed to ensure all contaminants are eliminated and the property is returned to a safe and habitable condition.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes assessment, extraction, removal of contaminated materials, cleaning, disinfection, drying, odor removal, and final restoration.
